name: Data Compression and Storage Optimization

# Data Compression and Storage Optimization

Also called: 3DGS Compression, Gaussian Quantization, Compact 3DGS

## Overview
This family of methods addresses the excessive memory footprint and storage requirements of [3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)](#1174-3d-gaussian-splatting-3dgs.md), which often exceeds 1GB for large scenes due to the storage of high-precision attributes for every Gaussian [S1, 12927-compact-3d-gaussian-representation-c3dgs.md]. The core problem is the redundancy in geometric and radiometric data across millions of primitives. These methods distinguish themselves from sibling [optimization techniques](#7922-optimization-technique.md) (e.g., [Sorting and Rendering Pipeline Optimization](12180-sorting-and-rendering-pipeline-optimization.md)) by focusing on data representation density rather than rendering throughput, utilizing techniques ranging from character-level encoding to neural field-based color storage and sensitivity-aware [vector quantization](#907-vector-quantization.md) [S1, 12927-compact-3d-gaussian-representation-c3dgs.md].

## Shared principles
All methods in this family aim to reduce the storage size of the [Gaussian representation](#5918-gaussian-based-representation.md) $\{G_i\}$ while maintaining rendering fidelity. The general approach involves replacing per-Gaussian high-precision storage with compact indices, [shared codebooks](#7563-codebook-sharing.md), or global fields. The common mathematical goal is to minimize the storage size $S$ subject to a rendering error constraint $\mathcal{L} < \epsilon$.

## Subtopics

### [ASCII-Based Data Compression](11820-ascii-based-data-compression.md)
Compresses numerical attributes into ASCII strings using base-95/94 encoding. It focuses on transmission bandwidth reduction through character-level encoding rather than spatial redundancy.

### [Sensitivity-Aware Vector Clustering](12167-sensitivity-aware-vector-clustering.md)
Reduces storage by clustering [SH coefficients](#5603-spherical-harmonics.md) and shape features into compact codebooks using sensitivity-aware vector quantization. It weights the distance metric with a sensitivity measure derived from the gradient of the rendering error, prioritizing parameters that significantly affect image quality.

### [Compact 3D Gaussian Representation (C3DGS)](12927-compact-3d-gaussian-representation-c3dgs.md)
Decouples storage size from the number of Gaussians by using a grid-based neural field for view-dependent color and a codebook for geometric attributes. It exploits spatial redundancy in color and geometry, eliminating redundant Gaussians via a learnable mask.

## Background
Standard 3DGS stores unique high-precision values for every Gaussian, leading to storage sizes that scale linearly with the number of Gaussians $N$ [S1, 12927-compact-3d-gaussian-representation-c3dgs.md]. Recent developments have introduced [compression](#4-compression.md) schemes to mitigate this, including ASCII encoding for transmission [S1, 11820-ascii-based-data-compression.md], sensitivity-aware clustering for [quantization](#5935-quantization.md) [S1, 12167-sensitivity-aware-vector-clustering.md], and [hybrid representations](#11926-non-baked-models.md) using [hash grids](#936-hash-grids.md) and codebooks [S1, 12927-compact-3d-gaussian-representation-c3dgs.md].
